A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same EGG-SR study. Their main text, equations, tables, figures, and complete appendices are readable and matchable despite substantial reorganization.

before.justification: v1 reports original EGG-MCTS, EGG-DRL, and EGG-LLM evaluations, together with search-tree, objective-variability, memory, and runtime measurements.

after.justification: v2 retains these original experimental results. Its explicit attribution of LLM-SR baseline scores to prior work does not negate the original EGG-SR results.

M1.justification: The e-graph construction and extraction procedures, MCTS sharing of search statistics, DRL probability aggregation in Equation 4, and LLM feedback augmentation are retained. Expanded explanations and implementation disclosures do not establish an algorithm change.

E1.justification: Both versions retain the trigonometric noisy/noiseless settings, four LLM benchmark problems with IID/OOD evaluation, and the same seven illustrated Feynman equations. v1's mention of ten Feynman equations versus v2's seven examples does not correspond to removed appendix cases.

E2.justification: The comparisons retain MCTS, DRL, LLM-SR, and array-based expression storage. Newly discussed related methods are not evaluated comparators. The changed LLM backbone label concerns the reported model setting.

E3.justification: Table 2 changes the LLM-SR backbone label from Mixtral to Mistral while retaining every score. This revises the reported model specification but does not establish a rerun or actual backbone replacement. The documented metrics, data sizes, and training hyperparameters otherwise remain unchanged.

E4.justification: The search-tree, objective-variability, memory, runtime, and appendix e-graph analyses are retained. New Example B.1 and Figure 7 explain equivalent MCTS paths; they do not report an additional experiment or robustness test.

E5.justification: Figure 3 retains empirical means and standard deviations of the estimated objective, and both versions disclose a fixed seed for generating identical test data. No new repeated-run counts, confidence intervals, or significance tests are reported.

E6.justification: All numerical entries in Tables 1 and 2 are unchanged, as are the experimental curves and appendix expression outputs. For example, noiseless (4,4,6) NMSE remains 0.006 for EGG-MCTS and 0.144 for MCTS. The LLM backbone relabelling provides no numerical performance change.

T1.justification: Appendix B.4 adds explicit operational MDP formulations, including terminal-only MCTS rewards, discount factor 1, and a formal DRL prefix-state policy. The regret bounds, OPD assumption, and Rao–Blackwell proofs remain substantively unchanged; their reorganization and notation edits are not new guarantees.

C1.justification: The unified framework and its two theoretical benefits remain the central contributions. v2 softens the introduction's claim that a general framework is missing and reframes the abstract's accuracy claim around discovering better expressions within the same time limit.

C2.justification: v2 adds substantive applicability boundaries concerning excessive rewrite growth, domain-dependent identities without systematic domain enforcement, and incompatibility with symbolic networks. Sections 3.2–3.3 and Appendix A.2 also expand explanations of shared MCTS visit counts, unsupported extensions, and rule-set-dependent runtime.

D1.justification: v2 newly specifies operational MDP details and excluded rewrite rules, and adds a project-page link while retaining repository instructions and hyperparameter Tables 4–5. Conversely, v1's disclosure of ten randomly sampled expressions per trigonometric group disappears. These are documentation changes, not demonstrated experimental reruns.

R1.justification: New Section 3.3 and expanded related-work passages substantially broaden positioning against symbolic networks, graph-based regression, and newer e-graph work, including Equality graph assisted symbolic regression and reggression. The revision also acknowledges a wider implementation landscape and moderates the claimed gap in prior research.

P1.justification: The abstract, introduction, preliminaries, and method explanations are extensively rewritten. v2 adds a connections section and numbered examples, reorganizes six appendix sections into four, removes duplicated main-text settings exposition, and adds ethics and reproducibility statements.

P2.justification: v2 adds the MCTS equivalence schematic in Figure 7, revises pipeline artwork and captions, reformats code listings, and relocates figures. Existing result tables, experimental plots, and appendix e-graph visualizations are retained with limited display changes.

improvement.justification: v2 makes the method and its scope easier to assess through clearer explanations of shared search statistics, broader prior-work comparisons, and explicit applicability limitations. These are useful gains without stronger experimental or proof support. The lost dataset-count disclosure, unexplained backbone relabelling, and fixed-time claim without new supporting experiments limit the overall improvement.
